|   |-- SessionInbox.reconcile(messageID) -> SessionPrompt.prepare(...) -> admission.admit(...)

|   |-- [D] Inbox item + delivery mode determine when input enters model history
|   |   |-- steer -> eligible during an ongoing continuation
|   |   `-- queue -> waits for a next-turn boundary; compaction/move are control items
|   `-- execution.wake(sessionID), unless resume === false
|       `-- Admission returns without making the client request own the agent run

|   |   |-- One execution per session; different sessions can execute concurrently
|   |   `-- wake coalesces notifications; run starts or joins; awaitIdle includes settlement
|   |-- [C] started -> Execution.Started + SessionStore.claim in one publication transaction
|   |-- [C] drain -> Instance.provide(session) -> SessionRunner.drain(...)
